title: Eggwars Premium
description: Eggwars premium mod for CubeCraft Eggwars. Includes armor durability, strength indicator, sword type, golden apple count, big emeralds, name history checker. Fully customizable sizes and colors.
body:
**EggWars+**

EggWars+ is a client-side quality-of-life mod designed specifically for players of Cubecraft. It enhances the in-game HUD with additional information to improve awareness during EggWars matches. It works on other servers too, however this has not been tested.

**Features**

_Armor Durability Display_

Shows real-time durability for each armor piece directly.

_Strength Indicator_

Displays when strength has been drank.

_Sword Type Indicator_

Identifies the sword being held (e.g. diamond sharpness 2, sharpness 5) without relying on textures.

_Golden Apple Counter_

Tracks the number of golden apples being held.

_Emerald Display (Big Format)_

Enlarged emerald count for better visibility during gameplay.

_Name History Checker_

Allows you to view a player’s previous usernames.

**Customization**

Fully customizable colors

Adjustable sizes and positioning

**Controls**

Open the mod configuration GUI with: ]
(This keybind can be changed in Minecraft controls)

**Important Information**

This is a client-side mod and does not require server installation

Designed for Cubecraft EggWars; functionality may be limited on other servers

Does not provide gameplay advantages, only visual information


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Data Collection Notice: This mod collects your approximate country of residence, and the number of times you have launched Minecraft with this mod installed. This data is sent to a private server and is used solely for usage statistics. It is not shared with third parties.

</details>
